swing_ideas.text:
Cup and handle-esque retracing nearly 100% of the earnings sell off. With an unfilled gap to close overhead, looking for breaks of the handle (or just call it a daily bull flag) to get over 105.85 and trend up towards the gap close at 110.3.

Not interested if price doesn't accelerate into the gap.

Ascending triangle with really well defined breakout point. Over 157.25 should get this moving into blue sky territory. Ideally the trend line remains in tact for longs to continue as a watch. Great relative strength on Friday.

S&P daily chart – Notice the daily 20 SMA is going to provide GREAT confluence right at the 613 area.

S&P hourly chart – Upside should take care of itself. Possible to call for head and shoulders with the Thursday high making a failed breakout. Under the neckline, offers the beginning of a pullback. I'm not fond of shorting the pullback paths for anything more than a scalp.
Market internals – To be expected mild reads as the market remains in a balance range. Nothing to see here.

Market profile – Value area has a clear shift lower on Friday starting to confirm the look above and fail that we noted on the daily / hourly. Not outright bearish, but bulls are getting a little tired apparently near the highs.
